thread:
maria (finance): UsagePulse quote review. Their pricing mixes per-token, per-call telemetry, and a "reserved credit" monthly fee. Can procurement list the clarifying questions before we approve the PO?
leo (procurement): I skimmed it; lines 4 and 5 look like telemetry + audit log fees. Need to confirm if telemetry is charged on committed tiers. Also ask about trial credits and how overage multipliers apply.
tanvi (eng-ml): Important: how do they bill streaming? Their doc says 'session' + 'token' in different places. If both apply on the same call we could pay 2x. Paste the SKU snippet?
maria (finance): Redacted SKU snippet below:
```
SKU,Unit,Price,Notes
UP-TOKEN,token,0.00045,per-token
UP-EMB,embedding,0.0020,per-embedding-unit
UP-TELEM,event,0.00002,telemetry/ingress-event
UP-SESSION,session,0.008,active-stream-session
RESERVED-MON,monthly,2000,monthly reserved credits (refundable?)
```
They also have a note: "session charges apply only if streaming==true unless waived on reserved plans."
joel (legal): Confirm invoice terms: net-30, dispute window 30 days, audit right, and exportable raw logs. Their standard 10-day dispute is too short for us.
anya (security): Security questions: do logs store prompt or full request bodies? Retention length? They list 120 days default; we need option for 30/90/365 and redaction/KMS.
tanvi (eng-ml): For reconciliation ask for: raw CSV/BigQuery export with these columns: request_id, utc_ts, user_id, model, token_input_count, token_output_count, embedding_count, session_id, sku_applied, cost_applied. And include example rows for three scenarios: small completion, streaming chat, batch embeddings.
leo (procurement): I'll ask UsagePulse to provide sample invoice lines for those three scenarios and show the CSV row that generated each line. Also asking about proration for mid-cycle reserved upgrades and whether reserved credits ever expire.
maria (finance): Add question about billing currency and VAT handling for EU invoices. And overage rounding behavior (per-second, per-token up/down?).
usagepulse-bot: UsagePulse AE: "Thanks for the questions. We'll send: 1) canonical SKU mapping with examples, 2) sample invoice PDF showing line mapping, 3) raw export schema (CSV+BigQuery), 4) confirmation: session waived for reserved plans, 5) SOC2 & SAML details, 6) log retention options and KMS support. We'll clarify proration and reserved credit rollover rules."
leo (procurement): Priority: High = SKU mapping + sample invoice + raw export. Medium = proration & reserved credit rules. Low = residency (we'll follow up if needed).
joel (legal): I'll draft the redline for dispute window and audit clause; circulate once I see their sample invoice.
tanvi (eng-ml): I'll prepare a short CSV schema doc to paste in the reply so they can confirm columns match.
maria (finance): Thanks everyone. Once Leo consolidates I'll approve sending the consolidated list to the AE. :thumbsup:
